description: This file provides utility functions for creating mock HTTP request and response objects for testing purposes, including functions to generate base requests, complete requests with body data, stalled requests, and mock responses, as well as a function to encode form data.

methods.name: export function makeBaseReq( makeBaseReq
methods.description: Creates a mock HTTP IncomingMessage with specified method and options, simulating a basic request object.

methods.name: export function makeReq( makeReq
methods.description: Creates a mock HTTP request with a body, emitting data and end events asynchronously.

methods.name: export function makeStalledReq( makeStalledReq
methods.description: Creates a base request that does not emit data, simulating a stalled request.

methods.name: export function makeRes(): ServerResponse & { _status: number; _body: string } { makeRes
methods.description: Creates a mock ServerResponse object with status and body properties, allowing setting headers and ending response.

methods.name: export function makeFormBody(fields: Record<string, string>): string { makeFormBody
methods.description: Encodes a set of form fields into application/x-www-form-urlencoded format.
